profile.headline: Software Engineer at Red Hat |  Software Automation Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead the development of Golang Automation tool to monitor Prow jobs and analyze various kinds of failures visualized via Garafana dashboards. 
- Contribute to the end-to-end tests for OpenShift API for Data Protection(OADP) operator that runs on various cloud platforms. 
- Configure CI pipeline in Openshift release for pre-submit, post-submit, and periodic jobs.

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Coordinate with Business Analysts, Development team, Project manager, and Product owner to learn Business specifications to outline resources required to conduct efforts in an agile workflow. 
- Responsible for analysis, implementation, maintenance, and development of automation framework and tools to support overall test architecture for a hybrid environment with a concept of "Continuous Testing" objectives for large-scale integration of the system in order to reduce manual test efforts, and execution duration, while increasing quality and test coverage.
- Conduct daily examination of business requirements and functional documents to create test strategies and test coverage in different environments and phases of testing. 
- Various tools and frameworks practice such as REST-Assured, Selenium, CI/CD, X-ray Test management, Sonarqube, Cucumber, Maven to perform end-to-end automation smoke/ integration suits that execute continuously.

positions.title: Leap Software Engineer
positions.description:
Received hands-on and lecture-based training in Professional Development, all facets of DevOps Lifecycle with Agile Bootcamp and Analysis in Agile framework to fit in Fidelity Businesses and Process. 
Worked on the internal legacy application used by the Corporate Technology Group with the demanded movement of functions and services onto the modern cloud with refactored scalable code.  
   - Developed Java RESTful microservices with Spring Boot and MyBatis, tested with the Mockito testing      framework. 
   - Collaborated on a cross-functional Agile development team to implement front-end.  
   - Utilized knowledge of conceptual, analytical, and computational by working on arguably high visibility functionality.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed Peak Spreading Statistical Analysis Tool that handles a large number of data for the North Carolina Department of Transportation and implemented the front end of the website with in-window browser feature that generates C3.js chart for the user
